info.name: Numberics Invoice APIs
info.description:
Run Auth → Login first (sets {{token}}).

• Dashboard: GET /v1/dashboard/summary
• Invoice / recurring / transactions / NMI / pay-by-token: see folders
• Onboarding: GET|POST /api/onboarding
• Taalr automation: folder **Taalr Automation** — receipt OCR + invoice via POST /api/chat (step-by-step requests)
• Taalr chat (general): folder Taalr Chat
• Public website chat (no auth): POST /api/public/chat
• LLC companies: GET|POST|PATCH /api/llc-northwest/companies
• Subscription: folder **Subscription** — public plans, subscribe, admin plan/subscriber CRUD
• view-detail invoice: POST body {"id": <invoiceId>}
• WhatsApp: Twilio sandbox — join code first (postman/README.md).
• Tax Intake: folders **Tax Intake — ProConnect** (legacy) and **Tax Intake — Multi Software** — GET /api/tax/intake/softwares + /{software}/upload|upload-sheet|template|list|{id}
• WhatsApp Taalr agent: same features as in-app; simulate via **Taalr Automation** requests 20–30 → POST /webhooks/whatsapp (no new API).

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: KPIs for dashboard cards. Import this collection, run Auth → Login, then GET Dashboard Summary. Super admin sees ALL; other users see only invoices where CREATED_BY = their userId.

request.description: Returns JSON: totalRevenueNmi (NMI SUCCESS payments), totalInvoices, roleCodes[], primaryRoleCode, dataScope (ALL | USER). Path: /v1/dashboard/summary under baseUrl (e.g. .../numbricsservice).
Update only invoice status for listing UI. Allowed: DRAFT, SENT, UNPAID, PAID, OVERDUE, CANCELLED, VOID.
Preferred PCI-reduced flow: frontend gets a single-use NMI Collect.js payment_token and sends it as paymentToken. Do not include raw cardNumber/cardExpiry/cardCvv in this request.
Optional NMI callback endpoint. If nmi.webhook.secret is configured, send it as X-NMI-Webhook-Secret or webhook_secret.

item.name: NMI Merchant Onboarding
item.description:
Run in order for local/production test:
1. Auth → Login (sets {{token}})
2. Set baseUrl to {{localBaseUrl}} for local OR production {{baseUrl}}
3. List Fee Schedules → copies first plan id to {{feeScheduleId}}
4. Submit Merchant Onboarding
5. Get Merchant NMI Dashboard (expect paymentReady true + ACTIVE)

Server application.properties required:
• nmi.reseller.api-base-url=https://secure.nmi.com/api
• nmi.reseller.api.key=your v4 key
• nmi.reseller.auto-complete=true
• nmi.reseller.processor.payload-template=... test_cc ...

Change contactEmail/username each test run (collection body uses {{$timestamp}}).

item.name: TaxBandits — Form 1099-K (Webhook + PDF)
item.description:
TaxBandits callbacks + helper endpoints added for automated PDF zip ingestion.

Notes:
• `/api/taxbandits/**` is intentionally public in this service (see SecurityConfig).
• Webhook must return HTTP 200 quickly; heavy work happens async on server.
• After PDF_COMPLETE webhook is processed, artifacts land under `uploads/taxbandits/webhooks/...` and `GET pdf-artifact` returns latest manifest.
• `POST /api/taxbandits/form1099transactions` → TaxBandits `Form1099Transactions`; `submit-and-create` (K), `submit-and-create-nec`, `submit-and-create-misc` → txn then Create with RecipientId mapping.

request.description: Official POST shape: root `TxnData` (see developer.taxbandits.com Form1099Transactions/Post). Replace BusinessId/RecipientId with your sandbox GUIDs. PaymentType per docs (e.g. NEC, RENT, ROYALTY, OTHERINCOME). Response: SubmissionId, StatusMsg, StatusTs.

Body: { "transactionsRequest": { "TxnData": [ ... ] }, "createRequest": { ...Form1099K Create... } }. Server sets createRequest.ReturnData[i].Recipient.RecipientId from transactionsRequest.TxnData[*].Recipients[*].RecipientId (order), then calls Form1099K/Create.
Same as submit-and-create but createRequest = Form 1099-NEC Create JSON; RecipientId UUID applied from TxnData order.
Same as submit-and-create but createRequest = Form 1099-MISC Create JSON; RecipientId UUID applied from TxnData order.
Quick health check for the registered Callback URL (TaxBandits verification / manual testing).
Local integration test only. Paste a real `FilePath` from TaxBandits Webhook Log. Set `tbSubmissionId` + `tbRecordId` collection variables first.

item.name: GET Form 1099-K — latest PDF artifact manifest

request.description: Poll this after `GetPDF` queues generation or after webhook delivery. Returns latest `manifest.json` metadata (relative paths to zip + extracted PDFs) if processing completed.
Queues PDF generation; actual URL typically arrives via TaxBandits webhook (`PDF_COMPLETE`). Requires webhook configuration in TaxBandits.
Immediate masked/unmasked PDF URLs (may be encrypted depending on TaxBandits PDF security settings).

item.name: GET TaxBandits — Download stored PDF (latest delivery)

request.description:
Downloads a PDF from the latest webhook artifact folder on disk.

Requires server config:
• taxbandits.artifact.api-key
• taxbandits.artifact.require-api-key (default true)

Set Postman variable artifactApiKey to match the server key.
